population_scope: Current observed 300-song discovery frame plus future scientifically promoted musical rows; discovery rows alone cannot support the musical association.
observed_pattern: PROTOTYPE PLACEHOLDER: a measurable musical feature X differs across explicitly defined observed-outcome strata.

association_evidence.method: to be estimated only after eligible musical rows exist

interpretation: If observed, X may support a conditioned compositional hypothesis; it cannot be interpreted as a universal mechanism of success.
theory_support: Required: peer-reviewed evidence matched to the actual emergent pattern before rule promotion.
deduction: If X is empirically supported within scope and survives the relevant controls, test X as a bounded melodic/structural constraint in a MIDI prototype.
note: This record tests the architecture and epistemic contract, not the substantive musical hypothesis. No synthetic finding is asserted.
